Twenty alias patterns searched across all 37 dossiers; hits are review candidates, absence is not proof of no later scene
Fifteen selected complete primary-dossier paragraphs in nine dossiers read, not a full source reread for every page
No new original ASR/audio, sheets, rulebook, art, maps, remote URL checks or rendered-site review
No article rewrites or character/place audit recertification
